lesson.guided_practice:
PRACTISE BEFORE READING THE FEEDBACK
Which unit: a grape; a school bag; a delivery truck?

FEEDBACK
g; kg; t (or kg for a light truck — tonnes for heavy vehicles).

WATCH FOR
Saying a school bag is “about 30 g” underestimates by a factor of a thousand.

INDEPENDENT EVIDENCE
Sort twenty objects into g/kg/t and write five conversion facts (g↔kg, kg↔t).

Write a short reflection naming one step you corrected and why.

Parent: Marking guidance for the independent task: Sort twenty objects into g/kg/t and write five conversion facts (g↔kg, kg↔t). Accept equivalent original responses that show the same skill.

Parent: Written model 1: Sample: new numbers solved with visible working for mass; key places/values named. Do not award marks for retyping the model.

Parent: Written model 2: Sample misconception: Saying a school bag is “about 30 g” underestimates by a factor of a thousand.. Correction uses g; kg; t (or kg for a light truck — tonnes for heavy vehicles).. Why: restores accurate mass.

Parent: Likely misconception: Saying a school bag is “about 30 g” underestimates by a factor of a thousand. Keep sample answers out of the child role.

Parent: Short-answer focus 1: Solve one fresh problem that uses mass with different numbers from the worked model. Show working and name the places or values that matter.

Parent: Short-answer focus 2: Describe one likely mistake with mass, show corrected working, and say why the correction works.

Parent: Marking notes: Accept any mathematically valid solution that uses new numbers, shows working for mass, and names places/values. Reject copied model numbers. / Accept a named misconception about mass, corrected working, and a method reason. Reject vague “I was wrong” with no repair..

teach_steps.explain:
Mass units relate by thousands: 1000 g = 1 kg; 1000 kg = 1 t. Choose the unit that fits the object.

WHY IT MATTERS
This helps the learner choose methods based on place value, quantity and accurate working, rather than guessing digits by shape alone. Keep every step justified.

HOW TO WORK
Read the worked example and name the places, values or distances that carry the method. Before looking at the correction, make your own attempt using the exact question provided. Compare your working with the feedback: did you use the same skill and show your reasoning? If a digit or place is uncertain, identify what would have to be regrouped or counted again. One deliberate, justified revision is more useful than writing a longer answer.
